items.q: she -- she went with Joe Louis at one time and I caught her in Detroit with Joe Louis.

ctx.x: She had gone with him before?

Oh, yeah. He used to beat the beJesus out of her. And he didn't have any prize there, you know, because she -- she went with Joe Louis at one time and I caught her in Detroit with Joe Louis. She was no prize at all.
But yet he kept her as a housekeeper to the end?
